title: Zepto Turns to Private Funding With IPO Plans on Hold for Now
description: Zepto Ltd said it agreed on a private share sale to major investors as the Indian quick-commerce firm pushed back plans for an initial public offering after failing to secure its anticipated valuation.

title: AI Isn’t a Catch-All Trade for Stocks in This Earnings Season
description: Equity investors are learning a harsh lesson this corporate earnings season: Not all artificial intelligence trades are created equal.

title: Can Africa Power the AI Boom?
description: Teraco Chief Executive Officer Jan Hnizdo discusses why Africa is becoming a key destination for data centers, how cloud infrastructure is evolving and why energy and sustainability will determine the continent's digital future. He speaks with Bloomberg's Jennifer Zabasajja. (Source: Bloomberg)
